items.exampleEn: With the deadline looming, the whole team worked late every night.
items.exampleZh: 截止日期逼近，整個團隊每晚都加班。

items.exampleEn: The earth rotates once every twenty-four hours.
items.exampleZh: 地球每二十四小時自轉一圈。

items.exampleEn: Photo manipulation has become very easy with modern phones.
items.exampleZh: 有了現代的手機，修改照片變得非常容易。

items.exampleEn: A small ladder was propped against the old tree.
items.exampleZh: 一把小梯子撐靠在那棵老樹上。

items.exampleEn: The strap of my bag broke on the way to work.
items.exampleZh: 上班途中，我的包包背帶斷了。

items.exampleEn: We need to align our plans with the company's goals.
items.exampleZh: 我們需要讓我們的計畫和公司的目標一致。

items.exampleEn: The moon exerts a strong pull on the oceans.
items.exampleZh: 月球對海洋施加強大的引力。

items.exampleEn: Many small businesses flourished after the new railway opened.
items.exampleZh: 新鐵路開通之後，許多小商家生意興旺。

items.sentenceEn: Please align the pictures so they hang at the same height.
items.sentenceZh: 請把這些畫對齊，讓它們掛在同樣的高度。

items.audioEn: A huge storm cloud loomed over the hills as we started our walk.
items.audioZh: 我們開始散步時，一大片暴風雨雲隱隱出現在山丘上方。
items.questionZh: 他們開始散步時看到了什麼？

items.sentenceEn: The farmers rotate their crops every year to keep the soil healthy.
items.sentenceZh: 農夫每年輪作，讓土壤保持健康。

items.sentenceEn: Strap the bike firmly to the roof of the car.
items.sentenceZh: 把腳踏車牢牢地綁在車頂上。

items.stemEn: Small shops ____ when local people choose to buy things nearby.
items.stemZh: 當地人選擇就近購物時，小商店就會興旺。

items.stemEn: She used a heavy book to ____ the door open.
items.stemZh: 她用一本厚重的書把門撐開。

items.passageEn: Every spring, a small theater group in our town puts on a play. The group ordinarily prepares for months, but this year the opening night loomed and the stage was still not ready. The director exerted all her influence to get help from local businesses. A furniture shop lent chairs and tables to use as props, and a sports shop gave straps to hold the heavy scenery in place. The hardest job was the lighting. The manipulation of more than twenty lights requires great skill, so a retired engineer offered to help. He spent hours making sure every light was aligned with the stage. On opening night, everything worked perfectly.
items.passageZh: 每年春天，我們鎮上的一個小劇團都會演出一齣戲。劇團通常會準備好幾個月，但今年首演日逼近，舞臺卻還沒準備好。導演動用了她所有的影響力，向當地商家尋求協助。一家傢俱行借出桌椅當作道具，一家運動用品店則提供帶子，把沉重的佈景固定好。最難的工作是燈光。操作二十多盞燈需要高超的技術，所以一位退休的工程師主動來幫忙。他花了好幾個小時，確保每一盞燈都對準舞臺。首演當晚，一切都進行得非常順利。

questions.questionZh: 運動用品店提供了什麼？
那位退休工程師負責什麼工作？
options: 調整舞臺上二十多盞燈

items.promptZh: 這家小咖啡店這幾年生意很興隆。
referenceEn: This small cafe has flourished in recent years.
The small cafe has been flourishing over the past few years.
rubricZh: flourish 表示「興旺、蓬勃發展」（例如 has flourished、has been flourishing 等）
「這幾年」可寫，例如 in recent years、over the past few years 等
時態配合內容（例如 has flourished、has been flourishing、is flourishing 等）

items.instructionZh: 用 rotate 造一個句子，說說你和別人輪流做某件事。
referenceEn: My roommates and I rotate the cleaning every week.
At work, we rotate the late shifts among five people.
rubricZh: rotate 表示「輪流（做）」，後面可接要輪流的工作（例如 rotate the cleaning 等）
句子要說到你自己（例如主詞含 I 或 we 等）
